scene.placeText: the great brass turntable at the railway junction of her steam city on a bright afternoon — a gleaming steam locomotive standing on the turning bridge in soft white steam, two great railway lines fanning away beyond, the glass-roofed station hall and its brass dome behind
scene.ownProp: a polished brass railway signal lantern with a ring handle and a lens of clear and deep blue glass
scene.outfit: a junction-signaller look fitted to her body — a short deep navy capelet over a fitted brass-buttoned bodice with a low square neckline, high-waisted shorts, two lines of silver rails embroidered down the front parting into a Y at her waist, fine leather gloves, laced ankle boots and a little cap with an enamel turntable badge
scene.scene: she is the turntable signaller of the junction, standing at the brass control post and holding up her signal lantern in both hands as the locomotive slowly turns to head down the other line
